text:
ravi: Quick question - planning to take 4 weeks paid parental leave, then drop to 0.6 FTE for 10 weeks to stagger childcare. Can I stack the paid weeks + reduced FTE, and is the childcare subsidy compatible?

kelly (People Ops): Short answer: yes, you can do paid parental leave then a phased-reduction. Two things to note: manager approval required for the 0.6 FTE period and People Ops must get effective dates before payroll cutoff. Subsidy eligibility is independent but has its own application.

ravi: Great. Any effects on benefits (health premiums, 401k match) while at 0.6 FTE?

jamal (Benefits): Good q - for short temporary reductions (< 12 weeks) benefits are usually prorated but most plans remain active. 401k deferrals will be based on actual pay; employer match still applies but pro-rated for contribution periods. We'll run a brief estimate if you want.

olivia (eng-manager): I support this plan for ravi. I'll approve the 0.6 FTE from 2026-09-15 to 2026-11-24. We should document core deliverables and on-call coverage.

kelly (People Ops): Steps: 1) ravi submit Parental Leave form for the paid 4 weeks, 2) submit Phased-Return/Temporary-Part-Time form for the 0.6 FTE with manager approval, 3) People Ops will notify payroll/benefits. Please include employee ID.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: monthly cutoff is 2026-09-10 for September runs. For paycode changes effective 2026-09-15, submit by cutoff or expect off-cycle processing (allow 3 business days). Include employee ID and exact dates.

ravi: How do I apply for the childcare subsidy? Is it automatic with the phased reduction?

jamal (Benefits): Childcare subsidy is separate - apply via the benefits portal. It's means-tested by household income bands and processed monthly. You can receive subsidy while on reduced FTE; we just need the FTE on file to calculate the correct amount. Link: https://benefits.redwood.com/childcare-subsidy

ravi: Any paperwork for documentation? Medical or court docs?

kelly (People Ops): For bonding after birth, submit the birth record / adoption placement docs within 30 days. For the phased reduction no medical docs required unless it's for medical leave. A short manager attestation + phased schedule is enough.

hr-bot: FMLA eligibility reminder: employees with 12 months service and 1,250 hours in prior 12 months may be eligible; FMLA runs concurrently with paid parental leave where applicable. Contact People Ops for FMLA intake.

ravi: Thanks all. I'll submit the forms today and ping olivia.

olivia (eng-manager): Thanks ravi, I'll add a handoff doc and set biweekly check-ins.

kelly (People Ops): Received - please cc people-ops@redwood.com so we have a paper trail. We'll confirm once payroll/benefits processed.
